content: Ndramak ari sik lepra udu tan
Jises edek udu mandrei eme andri, ya lau solo-an labai a-en hamon tan.
Ya ndramak ari sik lepra udu tan eme hawen, ma iy atehei bwili ndru-un i andri, ma iy tiye i buku doh, “Laban, i buku none ou aseken ou winiyan mesekei jo kamwenen ja udu mada Kindrei.”
Jises eme atehei minen i badan ma tawi iy, ma iy tiye, “Jo aseken. Ya ou amwenen ja.” Nawin bwe sik lepra iu ma iy amwenen ja.

Ano Jises tiye i tan, “Ou sasehek sala ta ari lau, ndri-iy, arile ou ales ala hawe iri pris, leheya badam ki tiri kanyolom. Ano ou adeu lakou kili ta salom i le buku Moses mene ndrabatanau, ya eme iri kanyolom ma katanan ou badeh, ndramwenen ja.”
Budon handru ta ndramak batun tinan ta bahun
Jises edek eme isos Kapena-um, ndramak batun tinan ta tondrok lau ta bahun eme hawen, ta ndremenya iy ta seben.
Ya iy ndramak batun tinan tiye i buku doh, “Laban, ndramak ta ndrahu so-ok tek ibo sik ndra-in labai udu kon, ma iy winiyan ta banyokolokon bwe. Iy akohok sisi-in tinan labai.”
Jises tiye i tan i buku doh, “Jo kameh ewek mesekei iy amwenen.”
Ya ndramak batun tinan tiye i buku doh, “Laban, jo ndramak ndra-in, jo winiyan baseken ou ta ame bolo asiu tek bwe, arile jo aseken ou asehek le sahou, ya ndramak ta ndrahu so-ok tek doh kamwenen ja.

Tasah, jo amwenen udu bahandra boto-on ta batun tinan ta tondrok lau mari ta bahun, ma jo badeh, lau tek rinek (100) ta bahun ale ado bahandrak. I buku none jo katiye ki ta ari lau anya, ‘Ou ala,’ idah kameh iy ilih. Ya, i buku none jo katiye anya, ‘Ou ame,’ idah kameh iy eme. I buku none jo katiye ki ta ndramak ta ndrahu so-ok tek anya, ‘Ou bwidi lahou doh,’ ya idah kameh iy bwidiy.”
Jises anuhun sahou doh ma manin atur, ma iy tiye ili tiri lau a-en hamon tan i buku doh, “Jo katiye tado handru, jo bandruni ari lau badu Isra-el tan budon tinan bala buku iy lau dah bwe.

Jo katiye tado, lau solo-an badu leheleh kameh ame, badu loboho an eme loken, ma badu loboho an i andri. Ya iri kameh akohok ndrahune iri ta manyah ta nyamon tinan hawe Abraham, ma hawe Aisik, ma hawe Jekop udu bahandra tondrok ta Kindrei.
Arile, oro lau ala Kindrei mene tiye oro ala ado bolo tondrok tan kameh akeh oro au ala manan, ala bolo lulik, ya oro kameh aden, ma andrebek lihi oro.”

Ano Jises tiye ili ta ndramak batun tinan tiri lau ta bahun, “Ou ala kon, saba lakou ou aseken, ndramesekei in hamon ta budon tam tinan handru.” Eme ya ndramak ta ndrahu so-ok tan ndramwenen ja na le liliy.
Jises mesekei lau solo-an amwenen
Na len Jises edek eme ili asiu ta Pita, iy atou salahu Pita ibo sik. Badan nyarahan ma iy amadin in bada sau.
Jises eme tawi le minen ma badan nyarahan nane iu, ma badih doh suri iy le eme loke, ma iy amekes na Jises nyamon.

Mirihik kon anya ka beyeh, ya iri lau atiye lau solo-an nane balik udu bwele-e iri ame hawe Jises, eme ma iy asehek le sahou ili tiri malawin ndra-in, ma tikahei iri au, ma iy mesekei iri lau mari amwenen ja.
Idoh ta amekes sahou ta propet Aisaya ndrasihidiy, asahan handru:

content.text: ma iy andrei sik ndra-in tataha iu i len.” Aisaya 53:4

content: Katin ta lau a-en hamon ta Jises
Jises atou iri lau solo-an labai awudi iy, eme ma iy tiye i toro lau tan au ala kapa gwa bilisiu.
Ano ndramak ari ta leheya kandriyen malen eme hawe Jises, ma iy tiye tan i buku doh, “Ndramak ta leheya, loboho heh ou ala aliy, jo kameh in le hamon tam.”
Jises tiye i tan i buku doh, “Iri mwi badu lokei, munu iri udu aliy, ya iri sirih ale awi iri ta matinou udu aliy. Arile, jo Nadu Ndramak Awas,
badeh, ari ndrahu matinou tek, bwe.”
Ano ndramak ari badu hamon tan eme tiye i ta Jises, “Laban, jo kili kihi tama op. Ano jo barawek bara-en hamon tam.”
Arile Jises tiye i tan i buku doh, “Ndri-iy ai! Ou ame a-en hamon tek, ya iri lau amak badeh, kado gwek. Idah kameh, iri lau badu hawe iri barala bara-eh iri.”
Jises mesekei siyer amondrei
Ano Jises sandroh ili bolo ndron ra-ei, ma hawe oro lau tan ma ronoh la-uh a-en hamon tan.
I le mani tur, siyer laba tinan atohou eme bwele-e gwa li Galili, eme ma bayau atohou eme bolo ndron. Arile Jises amadin.
Ya oro lau tan ala mete-ei iy, ma oro tiye i buku doh, “Laban, ou aseben to! Bwe kameh to katuh ai!”

Jises tiye i buku doh, “Ado budon tado nadu bwisik labai, i buku sah ado anoh tinan labai?” Ano iy suri iy eme loken, ma tiye sahou boto-on i ta siyer ma hawe bayau, eme ma siyer ma bayau amondrei i le rasan.
Eme ma oro lau tan mani oro atur, ma oro ndremenya oro, “Are ndramak i buku iy dah? Ya siyer ma bayau anuhun iy!”
Jises mesekei uru lau ma la-uh malawin ndra-in udu bwele-e uru iu

Jises oro ame asos kapa gwa li loboho kon tiri lau Gadara. Eme ya uru lau ma la-uh doh malawin ndra-in udu bwele-e uru, ma uru ado mada lek adek ame hawe Jises. Ya malawin ndra-in mesekei uru ala lolo-ou ndra-in labai, ma iri lau winiyan badek bala san doh bwe.
Eme ya uru ndremenya Jises ma uru arah i buku doh, “Ou Nadu Kindrei, ou anya amekes sasah keme taru? Ou ame dah ta adeu sisi-in eme taru, bwena ta len amwenen ta aliy?”
Eme ya, udu len sese, bou rakou aimon nyamon.
Eme ya malawin ndra-in tiye sahou tikisiy i ta Jises anya, “I buku ou tikahei aso ame len, ya ou suni aso kala bwele-e bou.”
Eme iy tiye i toro, “Ado kala!” Eme iri malawin ndra-in ame len. Ano iri sandroh a bwele-e bou, ma bou rakou nane dah sakaliye are bwele-e mandrei ame andri ala bolo gwa li, ma oro amak.
Eme ma oro lau ta atondrok bou nane dah atobwak au ala kon tinan, ma ala asehek tiri lau ta lakou mari asahan tiri bou, ma hawe lakou asahan turu lau nane dah malawin ndra-in udu bwele-e uru.
Ano ma lau mari badu kon nane dah au ala ta atou Jises. Oro atou Jises, eme ma oro ndremenya iy, ta iy karuwani kon tiri ma iy ki-iu.

footnotes.text: Kandriyen tiri Juwis iri anya, buku ndramak ari sik lepra udu badan badeh, iy ndrako-ak udu mada Kindrei. Ya buku iy anya sik lepra tan ndrano, iy kili hawe iri pris. Buku iri atou badan ndrasahan amwenen ja iri kameh tiye iy ndrasahan ha-un ja ta mada Kindrei. Ou anyolom kili ta Lebitikus kalan 13 hawe 14.
Jises aloh iy le Nadu Ndramak Awas. Nyara Jises dah leheya buku iy ndramak awas handru, ma Kindrei suni iy eme kon munyak ta aseben taha lau badu munyak ame hamon ja.
